about: I am a full stack software engineer focused on building reliable enterprise applications—from backend services and REST APIs to responsive web UIs. My background spans Java and Spring Boot microservices, React/Next.js frontends, and production debugging in Agile teams. More recently, I have applied the same engineering discipline to AI-enabled products, including retrieval-augmented generation prototypes that combine embeddings, vector search, and offline LLMs. I care about clear API design, maintainable code, thoughtful testing, and shipping software that holds up in production.
